comments.body: Engineering's update on the S01E03 Challenge page says original #4471 closed on 5 October and marks the hint WON'T FIX: booking-v3 form retired. Closing this 33-report hint ticket as not planned, not completed: retiring the affected form is not a fix to its misleading date hint. The parser was fixed separately and is tracked in issue 1. These are engineering-reported outcomes, not product tests run by this harness. See the signed resolution page: src/routes/kb/incidents/4471-resolution/+page.svx and evidence/engineering-update.txt.

title: Booking-v3 date hint contradicts day-first tenant parsing — 33 reports from #4471
